DEFINITION · qeva:1:existential-quantifier@1

Existential quantifier

Existential quantification asserts that at least one permitted witness satisfies a condition.

editoriallogic

PLAIN

The idea

Existential quantification asserts that at least one permitted witness satisfies a condition.

EXACT

The compact statement

Given formula φ(x), ∃x φ(x) is satisfied in M when some domain element assigned to x makes φ hold.

EXAMPLE

∃p∈ℕ such that p is prime and p>100.

BOUNDARY / CAVEAT

Classical existence and constructive exhibition of a witness need not be treated identically.
